The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e104c43128bea292), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. statement: Let n ≥ 2 be an integer, let κ ∈ R, and let (M, d) be a complete separable metric space. The following conditions are equivalent. (A) (M, d) is an n-dimensional Alexandrov space with curvature bounded below by κ. (B) With m = Hn d , the space (M, d, m) has full support, is RCD((n − 1)κ, n), and satisfies R(X, Y, Y, X)(f) ≥ κ Z M f |X|2 |Y |2 − ⟨X, Y ⟩2 dm (1.4) for every X, Y ∈ TestV(M) and every nonnegative f ∈ Test(M). The RCD condition is unreduced, and the test classes and curvature sign are exactly those defined above.
